title: The Masked Ball
text: Music from a lit hall, a slow waltz, and through the tall windows dancers in masks turning in pairs. A doorman in livery bows and offers masks on a velvet tray. Nobody inside seems to have a face to put one over.

options.label: The most charming goes in and dances.

outcomes.text: They dance until the music stops, and someone presses a gift into their hand on the way out.
When the music stops, their mask will not come off for a while.
The doorman is offended. So is everyone inside.
